pr_title: Favor parameter name in route pattern when available

issue_context.title: Client generated code, from OpenAPI, could not bind route parameter of a Minimal Endpoint when route pattern's parameter and delegate's parameter case does not match
comments:
Triage: We do have access to the `RoutePattern` in both the `ApiExplorer` and the new `M.A.OpenApi` package so we can determine the actual parameter name as defined in the route instead of the mismatched parameter name.

In general, we propose adding a new rule here that favors using the name in the template instead of the parameter name for request parameters where applicable.

review_comments: Do we need add a test for this?
Per offline discussion, added parameter name validation to the `Flatten` method too.
